notes: Single no-op turn in a muse session launched with an EXPLICIT non-default model (--model muse-spark-1.2; account default is muse-spark-1.3-contributor). Recorded with the interactive driver (driver-interactive.sh: `muse --trust-workspace --model muse-spark-1.2` in a tmux REPL, one send + wait_turn + 5s settle + exit_clean) -- requires the driver's settings.model knob to be ported from kiro-cli's pattern first (see metadata.json recipe preconditions), or the recording silently launches the default model instead of the pin. muse is a single-birth FilesUnderRoot adapter (no presession split); turn_start anchors to session_birth on event.kind:"started"; turn_end anchors to turn_start on event.kind:"terminal",terminal:"completed". ModelName resolves correctly to the pinned id (live-verified through the production parser+tailer against a real captured transcript: run.model.configured/runtime.session.metadata/model_completed all agree). ContextWindow is KNOWN FAILING: core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/parser.go's parseModelCompleted never sets tailer.TokenSnapshot.Total, so SessionMetrics.TotalTokens stays 0 and ComputeContextUtilization short-circuits before any capacity lookup -- confirmed live via a go-run probe against a real captured transcript (ModelName/CumInputTokens/CumOutputTokens populated; TotalTokens/ContextWindow stayed 0). Even after that parser fix, core/pkg/capacity has no pricing/context-window entry for any muse-spark-* model, so a second, separate fix (a capacity-table/alias entry) is also required. The spec asserts the CORRECT behavior per the never-weaken-to-match-the-bug rule; context_window_nonzero is expected to fail until both gaps close.
